change: Replace custom direct-address HTTPS transport and disabled proxies with standard urllib HTTPSHandler using ssl.create_default_context() and ordinary environment proxy configuration. No direct DNS prerequisite remains on the download route.
security_tradeoff: The candidate relies on normal DNS/proxy routing and the configured certificate trust store instead of connecting directly to a prevalidated numeric address. Arbitrary destination domains remain forbidden. Hostname and certificate verification plus immutable content hashes still authenticate the allowed official GitHub downloads. This restores ordinary enterprise/cloud proxy compatibility without disabling TLS checks.

HTTPS only; no URL user credentials
TLS certificate verification and hostname checking

Unchanged ZIP extraction, asset inventory and installer validation
